name: Shadow Bolt
description: Fire a bolt of shadow magic at an enemy.

name: Corruption
description: Corrupt an enemy, dealing shadow damage over time.

name: Curse of Agony
description: Curse that deals increasing damage over time.

name: Summon Imp
description: Summon an imp to cast fire bolts.

name: Summon Voidwalker
description: Summon a voidwalker to tank enemies.

name: Summon Succubus
description: Summon a succubus to seduce and damage.

name: Summon Felhunter
description: Summon a felhunter to interrupt and devour magic.

name: Fear
description: Cause an enemy to flee in terror.

name: Drain Life
description: Drain health from the enemy to yourself.

name: Drain Soul
description: Drain the soul of a dying enemy for resources.

name: Immolate
description: Burn an enemy with fel fire over time.

name: Conflagrate
description: Instantly damage an immolated target.

name: Chaos Bolt
description: Fire a devastating bolt that always critically strikes.

name: Rain of Fire
description: Call down fire on an area.

name: Banish
description: Banish a demon or elemental from the fight.

name: Demonic Circle
description: Place a circle you can teleport back to.

name: Dark Pact
description: Sacrifice demon health for a shield.

name: Soul Fire
description: Launch a massive bolt of soul fire.

name: Summon Infernal
description: Summon a massive infernal that crashes down.

name: Ritual of Doom
description: Summon a doomguard at the cost of a sacrifice.
